name: weather
description: Query weather for a city using Open-Meteo API

city.description: City name in English, e.g. Beijing

name: time_now

name: calc

name: web_search
description: Search the web only when freshness, external verification, or broader source coverage materially improves the answer. Returns ranked, deduplicated, source-diverse evidence rather than prose.

breadth.description: Coverage level; balanced adds useful Chinese community perspectives where relevant

providers.description: Optional provider order: tavily, serpapi, bing, duckduckgo

use_cache.description: Use local search cache, default true

name: web_fetch
description: Fetch or render a public web page by URL with cache, retry, rate limit, source quality score, cleaned text, links, status/final URL, and optional RAG ingestion.

max_chars.description: Maximum cleaned text characters to return, default 4000

render_js.description: If true, try Playwright browser rendering for JS-heavy pages

use_cache.description: Use local fetch cache, default true

ingest.description: If true, save, chunk, index, and add the page to the knowledge base

name: web_citation_check
description: Check whether answer claims are supported by source snippets/text and return an anti-hallucination gate with required rework for unsupported claims.

min_overlap.description: Minimum token overlap required for support, default 0.34

name: web_search_benchmark
description: Run an offline search evidence acceptance suite covering source ranking, freshness scoring, and citation consistency gate.

name: web_search_live_benchmark
description: Run live provider health and web search acceptance over 30-50 cases, producing provider success rate, p50/p95 latency, citation hit rate, by-scenario stats, failure reasons, and a durable report path.

providers.description: Provider order: tavily, serpapi, bing, duckduckgo

limit_cases.description: Number of live cases to run, default 40

offline_mock.description: Use deterministic mock evidence instead of network providers

use_cache.description: Use local search cache, default true

name: web_search_policy_benchmark
description: Run the frozen search-evidence policy corpus against real providers and report trigger confusion metrics, Wilson 95% intervals, citation hit rate, community-source coverage, deterministic answer-quality readiness, provider health, and per-case failures. Offline mock mode is simulation-only and cannot pass the live acceptance gate.

providers.description: Provider order: tavily, serpapi, bing, duckduckgo

offline_mock.description: Deterministic code-path simulation; never counts as real-provider evidence

use_cache.description: Use provider cache; default false for fresh evaluation

name: file_write

path.description: Full file path including filename and extension

append.description: Append to an existing UTF-8 text file

expected_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the current file for conflict-safe overwrite

create_only.description: Reject if a target already exists

preview.description: Validate and return planned hash/size without writing

name: research_pdf
description: Import/search local research PDFs, mark OCR-needed pages, validate citations, build comparison matrices, create reproducible workflows, and generate self-questioning paper learning analysis files.

name: learning_workspace

output_dir.description: Directory where the generated delivery package should be written

project_name.description: Project or product name, default ClawOS

scenario.description: Competition or enterprise delivery scenario label

output_dir.description: Directory where generated delivery and committee artifacts should be written

project_name.description: Project or product name, default ClawOS

focus.description: Review focus, such as final submission readiness or complex task acceptance

delivery_package.description: Optional existing competition_delivery_package result to review

final_min_score.description: Minimum final score for the quality gate

risk_min_score.description: Minimum RiskAgent score for the quality gate

judge_min_score.description: Minimum JudgeAgent score for the quality gate

name: template_list
description: List versioned project templates available in the local template center.

name: template_instantiate
description: Instantiate a versioned project template atomically at an allowed local path. Requires explicit confirmation.

name: knowledge_search
description: Search the indexed local ClawOS knowledge base and return compact source-bearing evidence without changing stored data.

category.description: Optional knowledge category such as research, learning, meeting, or project

limit.description: Maximum results, default 8 and capped at 20

name: knowledge_quality_benchmark
description: Run the reviewed 30+ case evidence-knowledge benchmark over real temporary SQLite ingestion, duplicate merging, conflict detection, retrieval, citation and task context assembly. Reports explicit truth boundaries and never treats deterministic corpus results as production user telemetry.

out.description: Output directory for the JSON report

name: paper_intelligence
description: Analyze stored PDF/DOCX research documents through a layout-aware semantic graph: headings, coordinates, table headers, figures and captions, formulas, footnotes, comments and revisions, multi-page claim evidence, references, comparisons and fidelity gates.

name: scholarly_search
description: Search and rank scholarly metadata across Crossref, OpenAlex, and Semantic Scholar, deduplicating by DOI/title and surfacing verified open-access PDF candidates. Requires network confirmation.

name: scholarly_download
description: Download a verified open-access scholarly PDF with SSRF, MIME, size, magic-byte, checksum, and atomic-write controls, then ingest it into the research knowledge base. Requires explicit confirmation.

name: coding_workflow
description: Run a repository-aware scoped coding lifecycle with structured compiler/test/lint diagnostics, stack-to-symbol linking, failure classification, explicit acceptance gates, checkpoint, atomic patch, tests, review and rollback. Inspect, test discovery and plan are read-only; execution and rollback require confirmation.

name: coding_agent
description: Use this for coding requests that require exploring a repository, reading files, proposing a scoped patch, running tests, reviewing failures, repairing, and returning verified changed files. It inspects first and pauses for approval before writes.

repo_path.description: Absolute repository path inside an allowed workspace

name: office_productivity
description: Create, edit, render and validate Office files. DOCX/PPTX replacements span text runs and preserve unaffected parts; DOCX supports comments and tracked revisions. XLSX updates preserve styles and invalidate stale formula caches; recalculate=true requires LibreOffice and complete formula caches. PDF updates support rotate, extract, reorder, delete, merge and annotate. Edits validate a temporary candidate before replacing output. Use capabilities to inspect supported operations; no WPS parity claim.

updates.description: XLSX: {sheet: exact name, cell: A1 address, value: string/number/boolean/null, type: text to store a leading = literally}. PDF: {action: rotate/extract/reorder/delete/merge/annotate, pages: one-based page numbers, degrees: multiple of 90 for rotate, file_path: PDF for merge, text: annotation content}. PDF operations execute in sequence against the resulting current page order.

name: autonomous_subagents
description: Run model-driven autonomous subagents with isolated role contexts, dependency DAG scheduling, schema repair, bounded concurrency, tool allowlists, budgets, checkpoints, arbitration, and an optional reviewer rejection to executor rework and independent release cycle. reliable_coding dynamically plans concrete edits, uses independent Git worktrees, verified restart checkpoints, three-way conflict resolution, integrated tests and independent review; requires confirmed=true, repo_path, allowed_paths and test_commands. It never writes the source checkout. reliable_coding actions prepare_delivery, inspect_delivery and approve_delivery replay the accepted patch in a fresh isolated worktree, re-run tests and acknowledge an immutable manifest_digest; approval does not apply or push source changes. Optional reliable_coding requirements freeze caller constraints, authorized paths and verification command indexes. python_exact_type rules permit bounded declared AST guard normalization after actual assertion failure; tests remain authoritative.

name: answer_quality_benchmark
description: Run the frozen 240-case common-task proxy benchmark for supported answers, citation mismatch, unsupported expansion, condition omission, missing citation, and correct refusal. Reports Wilson 95% intervals and never counts proxy cases as real user feedback.

name: answer_quality_validate
description: Validate answer claims against cited evidence and detect unsupported expansion, citation mismatch, condition omission, missing citation, and refusal errors.

name: selective_memory
description: Create, inspect, review, and explicitly promote task-derived long-term memory candidates. Sensitive, duplicate, and insufficiently evidenced candidates cannot be promoted; review and promotion require confirmation.
